whoami - displays logged on user information
whoami - displays logged on user information

EventData.CommandLine: "c:\windows\system32\cmd.exe" /c "powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command \Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -MaxEvents 200 | Where-Object { .Id -eq 1 } | ForEach-Object { [xml].ToXml() } | ForEach-Object {  = .Event.EventData.Data; [PSCustomObject]@{ UtcTime=( | Where-Object Name -eq 'UtcTime').'#text'; Image=( | Where-Object Name -eq 'Image').'#text'; CommandLine=( | Where-Object Name -eq 'CommandLine').'#text'; OriginalFileName=( | Where-Object Name -eq 'OriginalFileName').'#text' } } | Where-Object { .Image -match 'whoami|ipconfig' -or .CommandLine -match 'whoami|ipconfig' -or .OriginalFileName -match 'whoami|ipconfig' } | Select-Object -First 20 | ConvertTo-Json -Compress""
